meta.title: The Forgotten Temple
meta.description: You are trapped in a cursed ancient temple. A malevolent enchantment drives an eight-minute countdown — when it expires the stone chamber resets, erasing your progress. Worse, the curse is watchful: every wrong or premature move feeds it precious seconds. Solve the mechanisms, combine the relics, and escape before the curse reclaims you.

onTimerEnd.message: The ancient curse completes its cycle. The chamber rumbles and resets…

rooms.name: Entrance Hall
rooms.description: Dust-choked light falls through cracks in the ceiling. Carved serpents coil around every pillar, their eye sockets hollow. A sealed arch looms to the north; passages branch west toward the idol gallery and east toward the altar.

rooms.name: Gallery of Idols
rooms.description: Three stone idols stand on pedestals above a set of ceremonial scales: a sun idol, a moon idol and a star idol. A mural along the wall shows them placed one after another — first the sun, then the moon, then the star — with the scales balancing beneath. Faded carvings read: 'Day rises, night follows, and the stars watch over all.' A stone door to the crypt waits, sealed by the scales' judgement.

rooms.name: The Crypt
rooms.description: A low stone crypt, cold despite the temple's warmth. A sarcophagus lies open and empty. Clay jars of sacred oil line one wall, and an iron hook hangs from a chain beside them.

rooms.name: Altar Room
rooms.description: A cracked altar dominates the room, watched over by a faded wall painting: a robed figure runs toward a great golden disc with a staff outstretched, the disc seated in the staff's crown, golden liquid poured over it. Stone sconces sit dark and cold above the altar. An inscription reads: "Light feeds the stone." A locked iron gate bars the way to the reliquary, its bronze keyhole shaped like a coiled serpent. Rubble blocks a passage south.

actions.label: Light the Sconces
actions.description: Touch your burning torch to the altar sconces.
actions.failMessage: You need a burning torch to light the sconces.

effects.name: altar-lit
effects.message: The sconces blaze to life. The altar stone drinks the light and hums — somewhere, a lock stirs.

actions.successMessage: Golden light fills the altar room.

actions.label: Unlock the Iron Gate
actions.description: Turn the serpent-carved bronze key in the gate's lock.
actions.failMessage: The gate is locked tight. Its bronze key must lie beyond the northern arch.

effects.name: reliquary-gate-open
effects.message: The bronze key turns with a satisfying clunk. The iron gate swings open.

actions.successMessage: The way to the reliquary is open.

rooms.name: Collapsed Passage
rooms.description: The ceiling gave way here long ago. Fallen blocks choke the floor, and a dark chasm splits the passage in two. On the far ledge, something pale and folded lies in the dust.

actions.label: Cross the Chasm
actions.description: Swing across the chasm on a secured line.
actions.failMessage: The chasm is too wide to jump, and the rubble will not hold you. You need a rope secured to a hook.

effects.name: chasm-crossed
effects.message: You hook the line around a fallen column and swing across. On the far ledge you find a folded cleaning cloth — the temple keepers' own.

actions.successMessage: You cross the chasm and return with what lay beyond.

rooms.name: Chamber of Mirrors
rooms.description: Three bronze mirrors stand on stone pedestals, filmed with centuries of dust. A carved frieze runs the length of the wall: a figure cleans a mirror with a cloth, then turns the left mirror, then the centre, then the right, and a beam of light leaps from mirror to mirror into a carved eye — the temple's solar conduit. The mirrors will never catch the beam while they are blind with grime.

rooms.name: The Reliquary
rooms.description: A circular chamber. At its centre stands a stone pedestal with a star-shaped socket, and above it a dark crystal lens — dead, until fed by the temple's solar conduit. The exit, a massive iron door engraved with solar symbols, waits beyond. This is the way out.

items.name: Sun Disc
items.description: A flat disc of hammered gold, etched with radiating lines. It fits in the palm of your hand.
items.examineText: One face bears the symbol of a rising sun; the other has a slot that might accept a staff fitting.

items.name: Unlit Torch
items.description: A pitch-soaked torch. It needs a flame to be useful.
items.examineText: Standard temple torch — pitch-sealed reed wrapped in cloth. It will burn for a good while once lit.

flint-shard.message: Combining the unlit torch and the flint shard, you obtained a lit torch. It catches with a warm crack and throws long shadows across the stone.

items.name: Flint Shard
items.description: A sharp chip of dark flint, useful for striking sparks.
items.examineText: Knapped to a fine edge. Good for making fire.

items.name: Lit Torch
items.description: A blazing torch. It lights your way and ignites whatever needs burning.
items.examineText: The flame burns steadily, casting dancing shadows across carved stone walls.
items.useText: You hold the torch aloft — it illuminates the area but needs a specific target to be useful.

items.name: Hempen Rope
items.description: A coil of temple rope, dry but still strong.
items.examineText: Long enough to span a chasm, if only it were anchored to something.

iron-hook.message: Combining the hempen rope and the iron hook, you obtained a climbing line. The knots cinch tight — built for one hard swing.

items.name: Iron Hook
items.description: A heavy iron hook from the crypt wall.
items.examineText: Forged to bear weight. It wants a rope.

items.name: Climbing Line
items.description: Rope and hook, knotted together. Built for one hard swing.
items.examineText: The knots will hold. Somewhere a gap is waiting to be crossed.

items.name: Sacred Oil
items.description: A clay jar of golden oil, still fragrant after centuries.
items.examineText: Anointing oil for the temple's holiest relics.

charged-staff.message: Combining the sacred oil and the charged staff, you obtained an anointed staff. Golden oil soaks into the carvings and they blaze to life.

items.name: Cleaning Cloth
items.description: A folded cloth the temple keepers used to polish the sacred bronzework.
items.examineText: Stiff with age, but it will still lift dust from bronze.

items.name: Ancient Staff
items.description: A carved wooden staff banded with tarnished copper. One end has a hollow socket.
items.examineText: The socket at the top is exactly the right size to seat a disc or medallion.

sun-disc.message: Combining the ancient staff and the sun disc, you obtained a charged staff. The disc clicks home in the socket and the copper bands glow faintly.

items.name: Charged Staff
items.description: The ancient staff crowned with the sun disc. It pulses with restrained energy.
items.examineText: The combined relic hums in your grip, but its carvings are dry. It needs anointing before the pedestal will accept it.

items.name: Anointed Staff
items.description: The sun-crowned staff, glistening with sacred oil. It radiates readiness.
items.examineText: Solar symbols across the disc burn with a steady golden light. This is what the star-shaped socket was carved for.

items.name: Bronze Key
items.description: A heavy bronze key, its bow carved like a coiled serpent.
items.examineText: It matches the serpent-shaped keyhole on the iron gate in the altar room.

items.name: Sun Shard
items.description: A relic shard of the temple, one of three. Worthless for the escape — priceless to a collector.
items.examineText: Warm to the touch, as if it remembers the sun.

items.name: Moon Shard
items.description: A relic shard of the temple, one of three. Worthless for the escape — priceless to a collector.
items.examineText: Warm to the touch, as if it remembers the sun.

items.name: Star Shard
items.description: A relic shard of the temple, one of three. Worthless for the escape — priceless to a collector.
items.examineText: Warm to the touch, as if it remembers the sun.

hints.text: The serpent lock responds to light. Search the pillars for something to strike a spark, then combine it with the torch in your inventory before you touch the mechanism.
hints.highlightText: Carved serpents coil around every pillar, their eye sockets hollow

hints.text: The carvings give the order: day rises, night follows, and the stars watch over all. Sun, then moon, then star.
hints.highlightText: first the sun, then the moon, then the star

hints.text: The chasm in the collapsed passage needs a rope with a hook. One lies with the idols' reward, the other sleeps in the crypt.
hints.highlightText: a dark chasm splits the passage in two

hints.text: The mirrors are blind with dust. A cleaning cloth lies beyond the chasm in the collapsed passage. Once they gleam, follow the carvings: left, then centre, then right — with a burning torch in hand.
hints.highlightText: a figure cleans a mirror with a cloth, then turns the left mirror, then the centre, then the right

hints.text: The reliquary only opens to light and bronze: light the altar sconces with your torch, and find the serpent-carved key beyond the northern arch.
hints.highlightText: bronze keyhole shaped like a coiled serpent

hints.text: The star-shaped socket accepts only an anointed relic: combine the sun disc with the ancient staff, then anoint it with sacred oil from the crypt. The solar mechanism is dead until the mirrors feed it.

events.name: Serpent Lock
events.description: A stone panel carved with two coiled serpents blocks the northern arch. Their eyes are hollow — sockets waiting for flame.

steps.description: Retrieve the flint shard from the base of the east pillar.

effects.message: You pry a flint shard from the mortar at the pillar's base.

steps.description: Hold a burning torch to the serpents' eye sockets to trigger the mechanism.

action.label: Illuminate the Serpents
action.failMessage: The hollow eyes stare back, blind. You need a burning torch — combine something that sparks with your unlit torch.

onComplete.name: north-arch-open
onComplete.message: The serpents' eyes ignite with golden fire. With a grinding rumble the stone arch slides open, revealing the mirror chamber beyond.

events.name: Scales of the Three Idols
events.description: The scales must be balanced in the order the carvings command: the sun first, the moon after, the stars last.

steps.description: Set the sun idol on the scales.

effects.name: idol-sun-set
effects.message: The sun idol settles onto the left pan. A low chime rolls through the gallery.

steps.description: Set the moon idol on the scales.

action.label: Set Moon Idol
action.failMessage: The scales reject the idol — the carvings say the day rises first.

effects.name: idol-moon-set
effects.message: The moon idol settles beside the sun. The scales level with a second chime.

steps.description: Set the star idol on the scales.

action.label: Set Star Idol
action.failMessage: The scales shudder and refuse. The stars watch over all — they come last.

onComplete.message: The scales balance perfectly. A compartment beneath them springs open, revealing a coil of hempen rope.

onComplete.name: crypt-unlocked
onComplete.message: Stone grinds on stone — the crypt door swings open.

events.name: Mirror Alignment
events.description: Three bronze mirrors must be cleaned and then rotated in the carved sequence — left, then centre, then right — to feed the temple's solar conduit.

steps.description: Clean the centuries of grime from the bronze mirrors.

action.label: Clean the Mirrors
action.failMessage: You smear the dust with your sleeve and achieve nothing. The keepers' cleaning cloth must still be somewhere in the temple.

effects.name: mirrors-cleaned
effects.message: The cloth lifts centuries of grime. The mirrors gleam like still water.

steps.description: Rotate the left mirror to catch the light.

action.label: Rotate Left Mirror
action.failMessage: The mirror turns but catches nothing — you need a burning torch and clean mirrors before any light can travel.

effects.name: mirror-left-set
effects.message: The left mirror swings with a metallic groan. A thin beam of light appears.

steps.description: Rotate the centre mirror to redirect the beam upward.

action.label: Rotate Centre Mirror
action.failMessage: The centre mirror grinds against dead gearing — the carvings show it must follow the left one.

effects.name: mirror-centre-set
effects.message: The centre mirror catches the beam and bends it sharply upward.

steps.description: Rotate the right mirror to aim the converged beam at the carved eye.

action.label: Rotate Right Mirror
action.failMessage: The right mirror will not budge — the beam has not reached it yet. The carvings show left, then centre, then right.

onComplete.name: solar-conduit-fed
onComplete.message: Three beams merge into one blazing column and spear into the carved eye. Deep in the temple, the solar conduit wakes with a low hum.

events.name: Star Pedestal
events.description: A stone pedestal with a star-shaped socket. Carved text reads: 'The anointed sun-bearer opens the solar door, but only when the heavens feed it.'

steps.description: Place the anointed staff into the star-shaped socket.

action.label: Insert Anointed Staff
action.failMessage: The socket rejects your empty hand. It demands the sun disc mounted on the ancient staff, anointed with sacred oil.

effects.name: staff-inserted
effects.message: The anointed staff slides into the socket with a resonant chime. The floor trembles.

steps.description: Activate the solar mechanism to unseal the iron door.

action.label: Activate Solar Mechanism
action.failMessage: The crystal lens above the pedestal stays dark — the mechanism is starved of light. Align the mirrors in the northern chamber first.

effects.name: exit-door-open
effects.message: Light pours down from the crystal lens into the staff. Solar symbols along the iron door ignite one by one, and the door grinds open.

steps.description: Push open the iron door and walk free.

action.label: Escape Through the Door
action.failMessage: The iron door is sealed. The mechanism has not released it.

endings.title: Escaped!
endings.text: You burst through the iron door into blinding daylight. Behind you the temple groans as its curse, deprived of a victim, collapses inward. You made it. The forgotten temple is forgotten once more — this time, without you inside it.

endings.title: The Curse Resets
endings.text: The countdown reaches zero. The stone floor dissolves beneath your feet, the torchlight snuffs out, and when the light returns everything is as it was. The temple begins again — and so must you.
